FN-2YBLSI-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 69
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/04/2023
Senate Bill 69 as introduced removes the time limitations for Tier I firefighters, law
enforcement officers, and correctional officers covered under the Employees' Retirement System
or the Teachers' Retirement System to purchase eligible service credit prior to January 1, 2003.
The actuary of the Retirement Systems of Alabama (RSA) is unable to provide a quantifiable
estimate of the potential increase in obligations of the systems; however, RSA indicated the
impact is projected to be minimal, as the provisions of this bill would apply to a limited group
of members.
